metadata.title: Regularity for the prescribed vertical mean curvature system in the plane
metadata.abstract: We prove everywhere regularity for Lipschitz solutions to the prescribed vertical mean curvature system in the plane, where the codimension is arbitrary and the mean curvature is in $L^r, \, r > 2$. This strengthens and extends our previous result on the Lawson-Osserman conjecture, https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.04997 .
metadata.comment: 19 pages, AI was not used in any part of the manuscript, comments are welcome

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 平面 prescribed vertical mean curvature 的处处正则性
analysis.workSummary: 证明平面上任意余维的 Lipschitz prescribed vertical mean curvature 系统解处处正则，其中平均曲率属于 Lʳ、r>2；强化作者此前关于 Lawson–Osserman 猜想的结果。
analysis.breakthrough: 把二维处处正则性推进到非零且仅具 Lʳ 控制的平均曲率。
analysis.limitations: 底域为二维且 r>2；不能外推到高维底域或临界指数 r=2。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确声明稿件任何部分均未使用 AI，数学论证及全部写作由作者完成；不计入披露 AI 使用的稿件。
